findings: Behavior switches bind value then invoke shared save-settings. Previously reviewed Rust callback saves all general/font/plugin/AI fields, not only switched field. Unsaved intermediate values on other pages can therefore be persisted by unrelated toggle; no live UI fixture.

ToggleSwitch is custom Rectangle/TouchArea with click callback; no explicit keyboard/accessibility role handling in this component. Framework default behavior remains unqualified, so no definitive accessibility failure claim.

Settings window minimum720x500 and preferred900x580; sidebar fixed230 wide with fixed-height rows outside scroll view. Main content is scrollable. Small-screen behavior needs actual rendering, not source-only acceptance.
Dark settings theme is explicitly locked independently of launcher theme. This is deliberate comment/property choice, not lost theme persistence inferred from appearance.

Hotkey slot3/4 defaults contain mojibake dash string, but reviewed Rust initialization overwrites all four from saved setting. Visible corrupted default is therefore not established in normal startup.
Page navigation clears snippet error flags but does not clear snippet draft values in these callbacks. Draft preservation and actual save semantics need later page markup review.

Property declarations expose signed dimensions and callbacks but do not establish UI control ranges. Numerical bounds remain pending remaining markup; earlier malformed persisted-settings path unaffected by declaration alone.

Full remaining-file inventory includes Android source/resources, visuals/GIF, CSS, lockfiles, binary catalog, full desktop sync and this markup. Downloading or listing these is not source/visual review credit.
